name: Keep'em

features.name: Get'Em collector
features.description: Collects all visible cash symbols when it lands.

features.name: 15,625 ways
features.description: A 6x5 ways grid with drop mechanics.

review:
Canny the Can is back, now with Bob the Bird, on a 6x5 drop grid with 15,625 ways and a retro pixel look. Cash symbols worth 1x to 1,000x land across the reels and get collected whenever a Get 'Em scatter shows up.

Rated 3/5, so it's steadier than Hacksaw's flagship games, with lots of small cash pickups between bigger moments. The free spins build on Get 'Em collection. 10,000x max in every mode.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
